articles.title: Balkan: Kosovo droht dritte Parlamentswahl in knapp über einem Jahr
articles.teaser: Die politische Blockade im Kosovo dauert an. Bis Donnerstagabend sollte das Parlament einen neuen Präsidenten gewählt haben. Doch Abgeordnete konnten sich nicht einigen.
articles.image_title: Balkan: Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti leaves after attending a parliamentary session in Pristina on March 5, 2026, as members of Parliament fail to elect a new president. For the third time in just over a year, Kosovo voters are expected to return to the polls to elect a government, after deeply divided MPs failed to elect a president late March 5. Despite topping two general elections, Prime Minister Albin Kurti's party failed to secure support for its preferred presidential pick, falling at the latest hurdle in a crisis that had left the country without a functioning parliament for nearly a year. (Photo by Armend NIMANI / AFP via Getty Images)
